description: This file contains the Twig NameExpression class, which represents variable name expressions within the Twig templating engine. It handles variable lookups, special variables, and related compilation logic.

classes.name: NameExpression
classes.description: Represents a variable name expression in Twig, providing logic to compile variable access, handle special variables, and support deprecation notices.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NameExpression with a variable name and line number, triggering deprecation if the class is the base class.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for accessing the variable, handling special variables, defined tests, strict variable checks, and deprecation warnings.

methods.name: isSpecial
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if the name is a special variable.

methods.name: isSimple
methods.description: Deprecated method to determine if the expression is a simple variable.
